title: Among all the atoms from 21 to 25, list all the molecules that are carcinog
question:
Among all the atoms from 21 to 25, list all the molecules that are carcinogenic.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: atoms from 21 to 25 refers to SUBSTR(atom_id, 7, 2) between '21' and '25'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE a.XCL_001 BETWEEN '21' AND '25'
  AND m.XCL_011 = '+'
